title: Give only needed access
summary: Least privilege means giving each person or program only the access needed for its job. This limits damage from mistakes or misuse.
introduction: Least privilege means giving each person or program only the access needed for its job. This limits damage from mistakes or misuse. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Do not give administrator access merely because it is easier to set up.
